verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way to assign a conversation to a teammate or to route incoming mail to a specific owner. Team comments and @mentions only share an email with a teammate for discussion (shortwave-docs-10, shortwave-docs-11). AI filters and Splits label, star, archive and sort mail within your own inbox, which is adjacent but does not establish ownership. Triggers draft replies, add comments and create todos, again without assigning anyone.
